ei.title: Analysis — 실물 상품 직접 투자의 문제점
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본2

fullPassage: When investors decide to buy physical goods, they follow a direct approach. This approach provides the purest exposure to the commodity's price, but involves a cost. When investors buy commodities, they need to understand the quality of the goods and the problems that can exist if that quality is lacking. Another problem is the presence of different costs relating to storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs. These costs affect the management of the physical good. As a result of the disadvantages of direct investment, investors typically prefer to indirectly assume a position in commodity markets to avoid the problems linked to the management of physical goods.

questions.passage: When investors ①<u>decide</u> to buy physical goods, they follow a direct approach. This approach ②<u>provide</u> the purest exposure to the commodity's price, but involves a cost. When investors buy commodities, they need to understand the quality of the goods and the problems that can exist if that quality is lacking. Another problem is the presence of different costs ③<u>relating</u> to storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs. These costs affect the management of the physical good. As a result of the disadvantages of direct investment, investors typically prefer to indirectly assume a position in commodity markets to avoid the problems ④<u>linked</u> to the management of physical goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② provide → provides: 주어 This approach(3인칭 단수)이므로 provides가 맞음 / ① decide → 복수주어 investors에 대한 원형 정상 / ③ relating → 현재분사(costs relating to) 정상 / ④ linked → 과거분사(problems linked to) 정상
det.analysis:
❌ ① decide: 'When investors decide to buy' — 복수주어+원형 정상
✅ ② provide(오류): 'This approach provide' — 주어 This approach는 3인칭 단수. provides가 맞음. provide(원형)는 수 일치 오류 ← 정답
❌ ③ relating: 'costs relating to storage' — 현재분사 수식 정상
❌ ④ linked: 'problems linked to the management' — 과거분사 수식 정상
det.tip: This approach = 3인칭 단수 주어. 동사에 -s 필수.

questions.passage: When investors decide to buy physical goods, they follow a direct approach. This approach provides the ①<u>purest</u> exposure to the commodity's price, ②<u>but</u> involves a cost. When investors buy commodities, they need to ③<u>understand</u> the quality of the goods and the problems that can exist ④<u>if that quality is lacked</u>. Another problem is the presence of different costs relating to storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs. These costs affect the management of the physical good. As a result of the disadvantages of direct investment, investors typically prefer to indirectly assume a position in commodity markets to avoid the problems linked to the management of physical goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ lacked → lacking: lack은 자동사로 쓰여 '부족하다'의 의미. 수동태 불가 / ① purest 최상급 형용사 정상 / ② but 등위접속사 정상 / ③ understand 원형 정상
det.analysis:
❌ ① purest: 'the purest exposure' — 최상급 형용사 정상
❌ ② but: 'provides...but involves' — 등위접속사 정상
❌ ③ understand: 'they need to understand' — to부정사 뒤 원형 정상
✅ ④ is lacked(오류): lack은 자동사로 쓰일 때 수동태 불가. 'quality is lacking'(부족한 상태)이 맞음 ← 정답
det.tip: lack: 타동사 'The team lacks funds.' / 자동사 'Quality is lacking.' 자동사 수동태 불가.

questions.passage: When investors decide to buy physical goods, they follow a direct approach. This approach provides the purest exposure to the commodity's price, but involves a cost. When investors buy commodities, they need to understand the quality of the goods and ①<u>the problems that can exists</u> if that quality is lacking. ②<u>Another</u> problem is the presence of different costs relating to storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs. These costs ③<u>affect</u> the management of the physical good. As a result of the disadvantages of direct investment, investors ④<u>typically</u> prefer to indirectly assume a position in commodity markets to avoid the problems linked to the management of physical goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① can exists → can exist: 조동사(can) 뒤에는 동사 원형이 와야 함. exists(3인칭 단수 현재)는 불가 / ② Another → 단수 명사 수식 정상 / ③ affect → 복수주어 These costs 뒤 원형 정상 / ④ typically → 부사 정상
det.analysis:
✅ ① can exists(오류): 'problems that can exists' — 조동사 can 뒤에는 반드시 동사 원형. exists(3인칭 단수)는 불가 ← 정답
❌ ② Another: 'Another problem' — 단수 명사 수식 정상
❌ ③ affect: 'These costs affect' — 복수주어+원형 정상
❌ ④ typically: 'investors typically prefer' — 부사 정상
det.tip: 조동사(can, will, should) 뒤에는 반드시 동사 원형. exists → exist.

questions.passage: When investors decide ①<u>to buy</u> physical goods, they follow a direct approach. This approach provides the purest exposure to the commodity's price, but ②<u>involves</u> a cost. When investors buy commodities, they need to understand the quality of the goods and the problems that can exist if that quality is lacking. Another problem is ③<u>the presence of differently costs</u> relating to storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs. These costs affect the management of the physical good. As a result of the disadvantages of direct investment, investors typically prefer to ④<u>indirectly</u> assume a position in commodity markets to avoid the problems linked to the management of physical goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ differently → different: costs(명사)를 수식하려면 형용사 different가 필요. differently(부사)는 명사 수식 불가 / ① to buy 정상 / ② involves 정상 / ④ indirectly 부사 정상
det.analysis:
❌ ① to buy: 'decide to buy physical goods' — to부정사 목적어 정상
❌ ② involves: 'but involves a cost' — 단수주어 This approach에 대한 동사 정상
✅ ③ differently costs(오류): 명사 costs를 수식하려면 형용사 different가 필요. differently(부사)는 명사 직접 수식 불가 ← 정답
❌ ④ indirectly: 'indirectly assume a position' — 동사 assume 수식 부사 정상
det.tip: 형용사 → 명사 수식 (different costs). 부사 → 동사/형용사/부사 수식 (indirectly assume).

questions.passage: When investors decide to buy physical goods, they follow a ①<u>direct</u> approach. This approach provides the ②<u>least</u> exposure to the commodity's price, but involves a cost. When investors buy commodities, they need to understand the quality of the goods and the problems that can exist if that quality is ③<u>lacking</u>. Another problem is the presence of different costs relating to storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs. These costs affect the management of the physical good. As a result of the disadvantages of direct investment, investors typically prefer to ④<u>indirectly</u> assume a position in commodity markets to avoid the problems linked to the management of physical goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② least → purest: 직접 투자는 상품 가격에 대한 가장 순수한(purest) 노출을 제공. least(가장 적은)는 반대 의미 / ① direct → 직접 접근 방식, 적절 / ③ lacking → 품질 부족, 적절 / ④ indirectly → 간접 투자, 적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① direct: 'they follow a direct approach' — 실물 구매 = 직접 접근 방식. 적절
✅ ② least(오류): 'the least exposure to the commodity's price' — 직접 투자가 가장 적은 노출? 오히려 가장 순수한(purest) 노출 제공. least는 반대 의미 ← 정답
❌ ③ lacking: 'if that quality is lacking' — 품질 부족 가능성. 적절
❌ ④ indirectly: 'prefer to indirectly assume a position' — 직접 투자 단점으로 간접 투자 선호. 적절
det.tip: purest exposure = 가장 순수한 노출. 직접 투자의 장점. least(가장 적은)는 정반대.

questions.passage: When investors decide to buy physical goods, they follow a direct approach. This approach provides the purest exposure to the commodity's price, but involves a cost. When investors buy commodities, they need to ①<u>understand</u> the quality of the goods and the problems that can exist if that quality is lacking. Another problem is the presence of different costs relating to ②<u>storage</u>, insurance, and cash opportunity costs. These costs affect the management of the physical good. As a result of the ③<u>disadvantages</u> of direct investment, investors typically prefer to indirectly assume a position in commodity markets to ④<u>embrace</u> the problems linked to the management of physical goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ embrace → avoid: 간접 투자를 선호하는 이유는 문제를 '피하기(avoid)' 위함. embrace(포용)는 문맥과 반대 / ① understand → 품질 이해 필요, 적절 / ② storage → 보관 비용, 적절 / ③ disadvantages → 직접 투자의 단점, 적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① understand: 'they need to understand the quality' — 품질 이해 필요. 적절
❌ ② storage: 'costs relating to storage, insurance' — 보관 비용. 적절
❌ ③ disadvantages: 'As a result of the disadvantages' — 직접 투자의 단점. 적절
✅ ④ embrace(오류): 'to embrace the problems linked to the management' — 투자자가 문제를 포용(embrace)한다? 문맥상 피하기(avoid) 위해 간접 투자를 선호 ← 정답
det.tip: avoid = 피하다 ↔ embrace = 포용하다. 투자자는 문제를 피하려고 간접 투자 선호.

questions.stem: 실물 상품을 직접 구매하면 상품 가격에 대한 순수한 노출이 가능하다.

det.korean: 본문: This approach provides the purest exposure to the commodity's price → T
det.analysis: 본문: 'This approach provides the purest exposure to the commodity's price' — 직접 접근 방식이 가장 순수한 가격 노출을 제공. True
det.tip: the purest exposure = 가장 순수한 노출. 직접 투자의 장점.

questions.stem: 실물 상품 투자에서 보관, 보험 외에 현금 기회비용도 문제가 된다.

det.korean: 본문: different costs relating to storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs → T
det.analysis: 본문: 'the presence of different costs relating to storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs' — 보관, 보험, 현금 기회비용 모두 명시. True
det.tip: cash opportunity costs = 현금 기회비용. 실물 보유 시 다른 투자 기회 상실.

questions.passage: When investors decide to buy physical goods, they follow a direct approach. This approach provides the purest exposure to the commodity's price, but involves a cost. questions.stem: 투자자들은 직접 투자의 장점 때문에 실물 상품 시장에서 직접적 위치를 선호한다.

det.korean: 본문: As a result of the disadvantages, investors prefer to indirectly assume a position → 단점 때문에 간접 투자 선호 → F
det.analysis: 본문: 'As a result of the disadvantages of direct investment, investors typically prefer to indirectly assume a position' — 직접 투자의 단점(disadvantages) 때문에 간접(indirectly) 투자 선호. 장점이 아니라 단점, 직접이 아니라 간접. False
det.tip: disadvantages(단점) + indirectly(간접적으로). 두 가지 모두 반대.

questions.passage: When investors decide to buy physical goods, they follow a direct approach. This approach provides the purest exposure to the commodity's price, but involves a cost. When investors buy commodities, they need to understand the quality of the goods and the problems that can exist if that quality is lacking. Another problem is the presence of different costs relating to storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs. These costs affect __________. As a result of the disadvantages of direct investment, investors typically prefer to indirectly assume a position in commodity markets to avoid the problems linked to the management of physical goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② the management of the physical good = 실물 상품의 관리(정답). 비용들이 영향을 미치는 대상 / ① 상품 가격에 대한 순수한 노출(직접 접근의 장점) / ③ 상품 시장에 대한 직접 접근(투자 방법) / ④ 상품의 품질과 문제점(투자자가 이해해야 할 것)
det.analysis:
① the purest exposure to the commodity's price: 이것은 직접 접근의 장점(S2). 비용이 영향을 미치는 대상 아님
② ← 정답: 'These costs affect the management of the physical good' — 보관·보험·기회비용이 실물 관리에 영향
③ a direct approach to commodity markets: 비용이 접근 방식에 영향을 미친다? 문맥에 안 맞음
④ the quality of the goods and the problems: 투자자가 이해해야 할 것(S3). 비용의 영향 대상 아님
det.tip: These costs(보관·보험·기회비용) → affect → the management(관리). 인과 관계 파악.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① to indirectly assume a position in commodity markets = 상품 시장에서 간접적으로 입지를 확보하다(정답). 직접 투자의 단점 때문에 투자자가 선호하는 것 / ② 더 낮은 비용으로 직접 구매(직접 투자 선호 = 문맥과 반대) / ③ 보관·보험 비용 증가(투자자가 원하는 것 아님) / ④ 실물 상품 품질 향상(투자자의 목적 아님)
det.analysis:
① ← 정답: 'investors typically prefer to indirectly assume a position in commodity markets' — 직접 투자 단점 → 간접 투자 선호
② to directly purchase: 직접 구매는 이미 문제 있다고 설명. 선호 대상 아님
③ to increase costs: 비용 증가를 원하는 투자자는 없음. 문맥과 반대
④ to improve quality: 투자자는 품질 개선이 목적 아님. 수익이 목적
det.tip: 직접 투자 단점 → 간접(indirectly) 투자 선호. 문맥 인과 추론.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ③ 비용 미발생+선호 → 오류. 본문: involves a cost + disadvantages 때문에 간접 투자 선호
det.analysis:

④ 관리에 영향 → 'These costs affect the management' 일치
det.tip: involves a cost = 비용을 수반한다. 직접 투자에는 비용이 있음.
